470dacdb3cc4bcc332f5.title: Project Coordinator
470dacdb3cc4bcc332f5.description:
Exante360, Inc., is looking for a Project Coordinator that wants to join us on our bold initiative of “improving lives through relationships, by connecting people to solutions.”

**Role**  
The Project Coordinator supports the successful execution of projects by managing and tracking project tasks, schedules, scopes, and workloads through the entire project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Managers and cross‑functional teams, the Project Coordinator uses tools such as the typical suite of Microsoft products (Outlook, Office, Teams, SharePoint), but also PM focused tools like Asana and Procore to provide accurate project visibility and support delivery against schedule, budget, and quality objectives.

Exante360 is building an AI-forward organization. We are looking for professionals who embrace artificial intelligence, automation, and digital transformation as part of how they work. Ideal candidates are proactive in learning and applying new technologies, comfortable integrating AI tools into their workflow where appropriate, and capable of combining technology with sound business judgment to deliver exceptional results.

**What You’ll Do**

* Support project setup and mobilization across Project Management, Design, BIM, and Administrative teams, ensuring smooth cross‑functional coordination from project start through closeout.
* Partner with multiple Project Managers to help develop and maintain project schedules, plans, and milestone tracking to support on‑time delivery.
* Configure and maintain project frameworks in Asana, tailoring templates and workflows to meet unique project requirements and prioritize tasks and deliverables.
* Work with Project Managers to translate budgeted hours into clearly defined, assigned project tasks.
* Maintain accurate, up‑to‑date project data to support weekly coordination meetings and informed decision‑making.
* Develop and manage project look‑ahead schedules throughout the lifecycle of assigned projects.
* Participate in regular check‑ins with Project Managers to track risks, issues, and action items, and ensure timely follow‑up.
* Coordinate with external stakeholders as needed to support timely completion of project milestones.
* Monitor project budgets against actual expenditures and flag variances or concerns to the Project Manager.
* Assist with earned value tracking and reporting for assigned projects.
* Coordinate and administer change orders, Additional Service Requests (ASRs), and other contract modifications for Project Manager review and approval.
* Maintain organized electronic project files, including document control, submittal and RFI logs, and QA/QC documentation.
* Prepare and distribute project reports, dashboards, meeting minutes, and action items trackers to keep teams informed and aligned.
* Keep detailed records of project activities, changes, and documentation to support transparency and accountability.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of company standards, templates, and processes related to project management, communication, and administration.

**Sample Tasks You’ll Perform**

* **Set up and manage project schedules in a project management platform** by configuring project templates, assigning tasks based on budgeted hours, and maintaining look‑ahead schedules to support weekly PM coordination.
* **Track project financials and changes** by monitoring budget vs. actuals, assisting with earned value tracking, and coordinating change orders and Additional Service Requests (ASRs) for Project Manager review.
* **Prepare and maintain project documentation and reporting** by keeping organized electronic files, updating submittal/RFI logs, and assembling dashboards, meeting minutes, and action item summaries for internal and external stakeholders.

**Key Skills and Abilities Necessary**

* Possesses anticipation and scheduling skills, ability to efficiently and effectively plan workloads
* Ability to quickly adapt to project changes with limited notice.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Sense of responsibility, customer service, excellence, and versatility.
* Self-motivated and takes initiative without waiting for direction
* Excellent time management skills
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Exceptional follow-through and follow-up skills

**Education/Experience Requirements**

* 3+ years of construction or administrative experience required.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools for project documentation, reporting, data tracking, scheduling, and collaboration across cross-functional teams.
* Experience within the A/E/C industry preferred.
* Prior experience with Asana experience preferred.
* Certifications such as Project Management Institute CAPM or PMP preferred.
* Demonstrated experience using AI, automation, data analytics, or other emerging technologies to improve efficiency, decision-making, collaboration, or business outcomes.

**What We Offer**

We believe that the culture of the company, work environment, and job responsibilities present a unique working atmosphere in which you will thrive. We trust people to own their work, make smart decisions, and use the freedom they’re given to deliver exceptional results. We uphold superior customer service, strive for excellence, embrace versatility, and take responsibility in everything we do. Join a growing team that’s shaping an exciting, fast-evolving industry and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible!

We’re proud to offer an experience that not only makes work more enjoyable, but also empowers you to grow, stay energized, and feel supported every step of the way.

* Remote work environment built on intentional connection
* Professional growth through prioritizing your continued education goals
* Robust benefit package to support wellness and work life balance

**Who We Are**

Exante360, Inc. is an industry-leading technology design and consulting company that specializes in Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and Security systems. Guided by our Core Values, our certified professionals consult, design, and manage a variety of specialized low-voltage systems including telecommunications and data network cabling infrastructure, wireless (Wi-Fi, DAS, ERCES), electronic security systems (access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, security communications), audiovisual, fire alarm, nurse call, clinical communications, and other technology systems. Since our founding in 2013, our company has successfully completed thousands of technology design projects in various market sectors, including healthcare, education, data centers, critical infrastructure, corporate, government, biotech, and transportation. Our services include project management and construction administration to ensure that our projects effectively produce Intended Results.

Job Type: Full-time

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Vision insurance
* Long Term Disability Insurance

Work Location: Remote

ac693811ead29cef054e.description:
**We're not just behavioral health people—we're crisis people.**

Connections Health Solutions is a leading provider of immediate-access behavioral health crisis care. Our team combines medical and recovery-oriented treatment to stabilize individuals in crisis and connect them to community-based resources for ongoing recovery.

Founded by emergency room psychiatrists Dr. Chris Carson and Dr. Robert Williamson, our model is physician-led and data-driven, drawing upon more than 15 years of crisis care expertise. Recognized by SAMHSA and the National Council for Mental Wellbeing as a national best practice, we've delivered invaluable treatment to hundreds of thousands of individuals facing crises. Our commitment remains consistent, to improve access, inspire hope, and provide the right support.

Our values shape our decisions, define our culture, and foster continuous learning and growth.

We accept people as they are, creating safe spaces where they feel valued and respected. We inspire hope by walking with people side-by-side, showing them grace and compassion. We act with intention, holding ourselves and each other accountable, and doing the right thing. We work as one team, trusting and supporting each other. We embrace change and innovation, striving to find better ways to fulfill our mission.

We are on a mission to change the face of behavioral health. Help us save lives and make a difference.

  

**What You'll Do:**

The **HR Coordinator** provides administrative and operational support across the People function, helping ensure HR processes are organized, accurate, timely, and responsive. This part-time position supports day-to-day HR administration, employee records, benefits and leave activities, compliance documentation, and People team programs and projects.

The HR Coordinator serves as a resource for routine team member questions and requests, maintains accurate and confidential employee information, and partners with HR Business Partners and other People team members to coordinate follow-up and complete administrative activities. The position requires strong organization, attention to detail, customer service, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**HR Operations & Administrative Support**

* Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support across the People function

* Responds to routine team member questions and requests and directs or escalates more complex matters to appropriate People team member

* Provides administrative support for shared HR inboxes

* Provides timely replies to employment verification requests

* Supports HR Business partners and other People team members with administrative requests, documentation, tracking and follow-up

* Provides administrative coordination support for People programs, initiatives, and special projects under the direction of HR leadership
* Provides back-up coverage with onboarding new hires

**Benefits, Leaves, & Workers Compensation Support**

* Provides administrative support to the Benefits Administrator for benefits, leaves, and workers' compensation activities

* Provide backup coverage to the Benefit Administrator during peak periods, absences, or as workload requires

* Assist with answering basic questions and escalates as appropriate for timely follow up
* Assist with annual benefits activities and other benefit-related initiatives

**Compliance Records & Support**

* Partners with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) to proactively review employee files and records for completeness and compliance

* Partners with center HR to assist with any records audit related to a regulatory visit

* Maintains confidentiality regarding all employee records.

* Follows up with requests for information from government, licensing or regulatory entities such as unemployment claims, and validation of worked hours

**People Projects & Initiatives**

* Provides administrative and coordination support for seasonal and special People projects under the direction of HR leadership.

* Supports activities related to new market and center openings, annual enrollment, employee engagement initiatives, audits, and other People programs.Assists with project tracking, scheduling, documentation, communications, and follow-up as assigned.
* Provides additional administrative support across the People function based on business needs and priorities.

**This is a part-time position, averaging 20 hours/week.**

**This is a fully remote position in these states:** **AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MT, NC, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI**

**What You'll Bring:**

* 2 years of Human Resources experience
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Familiarity with benefits rules and regulations
* Ability to work professionally with a diverse range of individuals
* **The Company has a mandatory vaccination policy. All successful applicants must be fully vaccinated, including showing proper documentation, or otherwise be exempt pursuant to the Company's exemption process prior to their start date as a condition of employment**

**It would be great if you had:**

* Work experience in the healthcare industry
* Familiarity with HRIS platforms
* Experience with employment law, benefits, leave and workers compensation

**What We Offer:**

  

Full-time only:

* Employees (and their families) are offered comprehensive health insurance, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
* CHS pays for Basic Life, AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability
* Voluntary Life insurance option for employees and their families
* Health Savings Accounts (with $1,000 to $2,000 employer contribution depending on plan)
* Flexible Spending Accounts (health care and dependent care)
* 401k company match after 6 months (50% of deferrals up to 6% of compensation)
* Generous PTO starting at 160 hours accrued annually and 12 recognized company holidays
* Company‑paid parental leave available to eligible employees

All employees (Pool, Part-time and Full-time):

* Employee Assistance Program to help with confidential emotional support, work life solutions, financial solutions, legal assistance, or online support
* After 90 days, you are auto enrolled in the 401k Plan

-----------------

We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment for all employees and applicants.

Please note:

d6c8f01e64234e9632ab.title: Construction Coordinator Intern (Electrical) - Summer 2027
d6c8f01e64234e9632ab.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

**Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

**Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

**Position Title:** Construction Coordinator (Electrical Intern) - Summer of 2027

**Position Location:** Across the United States, depending on project location

**Position Schedule:** The anticipated work schedule is **Monday through Friday,** generally from **7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m**., with lunch provided on-site. **All approved business travel, lodging, and project-related living expenses will be covered for the duration of the assignment**. To help maintain work-life balance, interns will have the opportunity to travel home every other weekend, subject to project schedules and manager approval.

**Job Summary**

The **Construction Coordinator Intern (Electrical)** will support the contractor and/or owner's representative throughout all phases of a mission-critical construction project. Working alongside experienced construction professionals, you'll gain hands-on exposure to project planning, field coordination, quality assurance, scheduling, safety, and project delivery while helping ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

Throughout the internship, you'll assist with tracking project progress, maintaining project documentation, and coordinating with architects, engineers, contractors, and clients. From pre-construction planning through project turnover and closeout, you'll develop practical experience supporting reporting, risk management, issue resolution, and day-to-day construction operations.

This is a structured learning opportunity designed for individuals beginning their careers in construction management. You'll work under the guidance of experienced professionals, receive mentorship, and build the technical and professional skills needed to succeed in the construction industry while learning DLB Associates' processes, standards, and best practices.

The Construction Coordinator Intern (Electrical) is expected to communicate professionally and collaborate effectively with project teams while supporting DLB Associates' commitment to safety, quality, integrity, and exceptional client service.

**Essential Functions**

* Assist project teams with contract administration and coordination meetings.
* Support document tracking, including submittals, RFIs, and change orders.
* Help monitor project schedules and budgets using company tools and templates.
* Assist in preparing reports and presentations summarizing project progress and key metrics.
* Support field teams in verifying installations meet design and quality expectations.
* Help document construction activities through photos, logs, and progress summaries.
* Assist in collecting and organizing closeout documentation.
* Learn about risk management, safety, and quality assurance practices on active job sites.
* Prepare visual materials and reports for internal and client-facing updates.
* Participate in team meetings and contribute to discussions on project improvements.
* Maintain professional communication and collaboration with team members and contractors.
* Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
* Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

**Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget**

*Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned*

**Position Requirements (BEGINNER level for all the following)**

* Knowledge of fundamental construction and project management principles, including scheduling, budgeting, coordination practices, and the materials, methods, and tools used in commercial or mission-critical facilities.
* Ability to learn commissioning processes for electrical, mechanical, and controls systems in mission-critical environments.
* Ability to communicate clearly and concisely with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to learn construction management software such as Procore.
* Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail.
* Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management.
* Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation
* Ability to follow company and site safety requirements.
* Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence.
* Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with onsite and remote team members.
* Ability to analyze complex information and develop plans to address identified issues.

**Physical Demands**

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:**

  

* Frequently manipulating small parts/tools
* Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
* Frequently moving through data center and outdoor environments (heat, cold, precipitation), including navigating tight spaces, accessing areas via stairs or ladders, and occasionally working in overhead or under-equipment positions.
* On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

**Travel Requirements**

* Must have a valid driver’s license
* Assigned to a Data Center project near Buffalo, New York and required to be on-site there Monday through Friday, generally from 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
* Interns will be permitted to travel home every other weekend, subject to project schedules and management approval.
* You will be issued a corporate American Express card to cover project-related travel expenses, including airfare, lodging, meals, and other approved costs.
* Effective May 7, 2025, and in accordance with U.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) is required for travel associated with this position.
* Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.
* Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business needs.

**CERTIFICATIONS & SAFETY**

Ability to achieve NFPA 70E and/or OSHA training as required; strict adherence to HSE/LOTO policies.

**Education / Experience**

In pursuit of a bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, or related discipline.

**AND**

One year of hands‑on install/testing/validation/troubleshooting of mechanical, controls, and/or electrical infrastructure.

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!

  

**NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:**

DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to DLB in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where DLB has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of DLB and DLB will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

42,000 - 59,062 USD per year (Remote (United States))

a8539ca88924b783d79e.title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
a8539ca88924b783d79e.description:
Epoch AI is looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to keep our hiring accurate, organized, and responsive as we grow.

### **About the Role**

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to own the administrative and data backbone of hiring at Epoch. You will report to the Head of People and work alongside our recruiters, hiring managers, and our People Operations and Finance teams.

Epoch has grown from roughly 20 people to 70 during 2026, with staff employed across North and South America and Europe. That pace produces a large volume of candidates, interviews, work tests, and records, and the quality of our hiring decisions depends on that volume being handled carefully. Much of your first year will go to making our applicant tracking system reliable, our reporting usable, and our candidate experience consistent.

The role covers data hygiene and reporting in our applicant tracking system, candidate communications, administration of work tests and skills assessments, and administrative support to recruiters as needed. As you settle in, you will have the opportunity to take on application review and talent sourcing, which makes this a strong fit for someone who wants to move into a recruiter role over time.

Recruiting volume ebbs and flows. When hiring slows, you will support the People Operations team as the organization's needs shift, which will give you exposure to the wider employee lifecycle.

### **Practicalities**

**Location**

Global Remote

**Work Hours**

Flexible, with availability required from 8:30AM - 10:00 AM PST/ 5:30PM - 7:00PM CET

**Travel Requirement**

Employees are expected to attend our 3 in-person retreats each year

**Compensation**

Annual salary of $78k - $95k USD. Exact salary will reflect experience and location. Salaries are not restricted to USD; contracts and payments are usually in local currencies, converted at one-year average exchange rates

**Benefits**

* Comprehensive health insurance program, including supplemental benefits specific to a local country, as available and mandated by local law
* Life insurance and retirement contributions plan, if applicable in your country
* Unlimited PTO with a recommend minimum of 30 days off per year (including public local holidays and vacation time)
* Unlimited personal and sick leave
* Parental leave — up to 4 months of paid leave for permanent staff with at least 12 months of tenure, prorated for those with less tenure, to be taken within the first year after a child’s birth or adoption
* A flexible and generous expense policy for you to spend on equipment and a large range of productivity tools or learning/development opportunities you might find valuable, subject to regulations and manager approval.
* Other benefits as allowed at the discretion of Epoch AI’s leadership and local availability

  

**Reports to**

Head of People

**Start Date**

As soon as the successful candidate is available

**Application Deadline**

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply early

### **What You'll Own**

**Applicant tracking system and reporting**

* Own the accuracy of our applicant tracking system: duplicate records, stalled pipelines, missing feedback, mislabelled stages, and candidates sitting in the wrong place
* Set up each hiring round in the system, including stages, interview kits, feedback forms, and permissions
* Maintain and improve templates
* Post roles to our careers page and to external boards and communities
* Maintain an up-to-date hiring tracker
* Produce regular reporting on pipeline volume, time to hire, stage conversion, and source of applicants
* Own ATS integrations with support from the IT team

  

**Work tests and skills assessments**

* Own the administration of work tests and skills assessments end to end: issuing them, tracking what comes back, getting responses in front of reviewers, and ensuring candidates get paid
* Assist with the drafting, formatting and filing of skills assessments

**Administrative support to recruiters**

* Manage the careers inbox: answer basic candidate questions, route what needs a decision, and ensure timely responses to candidates
* Assist recruiters with sending status updates, rejections, and next-step instructions to candidates as required
* Schedule interviews across time zones, working around interviewer calendars and candidate constraints
* Take on other administrative work that keeps active rounds moving

**Growth into recruiting, and People Operations support**

* As you settle in, gain exposure to application review against agreed criteria and to sourcing candidates for open roles
* As recruitment volume ebbs and flows, as capacity allows you will assist the People Operation team, offering exposure to the full employee lifecycle.

### **About You**

### **Must Haves**

* 1-3 years in a coordination, administrative, or operations role, ideally supporting hiring
* Hands-on experience working in an applicant tracking system, CRM, or similar software
* You find keeping data clean and current satisfying
* Comfort with spreadsheets and basic reporting
* Clear, warm written communication
* Strong organization and attention to detail
* Discretion with confidential candidate and employee information
* Comfort with remote work and with asynchronous communication across time zones

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Prior familiarity with and interest in Epoch's mission
* Experience using Lever or a comparable applicant tracking system
* Experience at a small organization that grew quickly
* Exposure to sourcing, application review, or other recruiting work
* Experience coordinating hiring across multiple countries
* Comfort automating repetitive work, using Claude and other integrations
* An interest in moving into a recruiter role over time

If you don't tick all these boxes but think you would be a great fit, please consider applying anyway!

### **Additional Information**

Please submit all of your application materials in **English** and note that we require professional level English proficiency.

Please do not include a cover letter, photograph, or headshot of yourself, or any personal information that is not relevant to the role for which you're applying (including marital status, age, identity traits, etc.).

However, we will not review applications submitted to this email address; please submit your application through the link on this page.

### **About Epoch AI**

Epoch AI is a research institute that investigates trends in machine learning and the economic consequences of AI. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive, publicly accessible knowledge base on AI that informs policymakers, industry leaders, and society at large.

We strive to achieve both rigor and accessibility to our work, as exemplified by some of our most successful projects, including our database of AI models and our AI trends dashboard. **POSITION OVERVIEW:**

The Project Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating cross-functional strategic initiatives that support organizational growth, business transformation, operational excellence, and client engagement activities. This role serves as a central point of coordination among internal stakeholders, leadership teams, client organizations, and external partners to ensure projects are executed on time, within scope, and within budget. The Project Manager drives project planning, risk management, resource alignment, and operational execution while supporting strategic priorities, transformation initiatives, integration activities, and client-focused business objectives across the CMO/CDMO industry.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

*This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented and changed as necessary.*

* Develop, maintain, and manage detailed project plans, timelines, workstreams, and implementation roadmaps utilizing tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar project management platforms.
* Drive project execution by monitoring deliverables, tracking milestones, and ensuring alignment with organizational objectives, client expectations, and transformation strategies.
* Lead cross-functional project meetings involving Commercial, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Business Development, and external stakeholders as required.
* Facilitate communication and collaboration among stakeholders to ensure timely decision-making, issue resolution, and effective project execution.
* Identify critical path activities, project dependencies, operational risks, and business challenges that may impact timelines, budgets, or strategic objectives.
* Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies, contingency plans, and escalation processes to minimize disruptions and maintain project momentum.
* Monitor project budgets, forecast resource requirements, and support financial planning activities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Evaluate and manage project scope changes while assessing impacts to timelines, budgets, resources, and overall business objectives.
* Support strategic initiatives including business transformation programs, operational improvement efforts, organizational change management activities, and growth-related projects.
* Coordinate activities associated with mergers, acquisitions, integrations, client onboarding, strategic partnerships, and other corporate development initiatives, as applicable.
* Partner with functional leaders to ensure project activities align with company objectives, client commitments, and operational capabilities.
* Develop project status reports, dashboards, executive presentations, and governance materials for leadership review and decision-making.
* Maintain project documentation, decision logs, action item trackers, risk registers, and governance records to support transparency and accountability.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure successful achievement of project milestones, strategic objectives, and client deliverables.
* Drive continuous improvement in project management processes, tools, governance practices, and operational workflows to enhance execution and organizational effectiveness.
* Other duties as assigned. These job requirements are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the education, experience, skills, knowledge, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

*Education*

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Life Sciences, Engineering, Operations Management, Finance, or a related discipline required.
* Advanced degree (MBA, MS, or equivalent) strongly preferred.

*Experience*

* Minimum of 5 years of experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, CMO/CDMO, consulting, or related industries.
* At least 3 to 5 years of direct project or program management experience supporting strategic, operational, transformation, integration, or business initiatives.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams and complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Experience supporting business transformation, operational improvement, M&A integration, organizational change, or strategic planning initiatives preferred.
* Demonstrated understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing, commercialization, outsourced development and manufacturing services, or related business operations is preferred.

*Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities*

* Strong understanding of project management methodologies and best practices, including project planning, governance, risk management, and change management.
* Proven project planning, scheduling, budgeting, resource management, and execution capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex business challenges and implement practical solutions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence and drive alignment across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Experience utilizing project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Asana, or similar systems.
* Strong organizational skills with a high attention to detail and ability to maintain comprehensive project documentation.
* Self-starter with the ability to work independently while effectively collaborating across teams and organizational levels.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, clients, and external stakeholders.
* PMP certification or formal project management training is a plus.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS****:**

*Physical Demands***:**

The physical demands described here are representative of the requirements that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer keyboard and mouse; reach with hands and arms; talk and listen. The employee is frequently required to walk and sit, as well as to lift and carry objects such as books and files weighing up to 25 pounds. The employee is occasionally required to stand, stoop, or kneel. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

*Work Environment***:**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, including moderate noise level, an indoor temperate environment, and light levels that are bright and conducive to minimal eye strain, typical for an office environment.

**TOTAL REWARDS PROGRAM****:**

We define total rewards as compensation, benefits, remote work/flexibility, development, recognition, and our culture with programs that support each of our reward pillars. This includes a market competitive base salary, robust benefit offerings, and ongoing recognition and career development opportunities. Employees also enjoy our generous paid time away program and company-paid holidays.

The expected salary range for this position is $150,000 to $160,000 yearly. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

* Paid time off & Holiday Pay

* Hybrid Work Schedule
* Onsite Gym

Description:

**Position Summary**

The Career Pathways Specialist connects Career Seekers with employment, education, training, apprenticeship, and career pathway opportunities that support long-term career success. This position collaborates with Workforce Advisors, Job Developers, Business Services, and training providers to help Career Seekers identify career goals, access workforce resources, participate in training opportunities, and transition into employment. The Specialist coordinates career pathway activities, promotes workforce opportunities, builds partnerships with employers and training providers, and supports Career Seekers in connecting education and training to employment.

training opportunities, and transition into employment. The Specialist coordinates career pathway activities, promotes workforce opportunities, builds partnerships with employers and training providers, and supports Career Seekers in connecting education and training to employment.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Career Pathways & Customer Support

* Provide excellent customer service to all Career Seekers.
* Assist Career Seekers in identifying career goals, career pathways, education, and training opportunities aligned with their interests, skills, and employment goals.
* Provide career coaching and guidance to support informed career and training decisions.
* Recommend workforce resources and services based on each Career Seeker's individual needs.
* Refer Career Seekers to Workforce Advisors, Job Developers, workshops, and partner agencies as appropriate.
* Conduct workshops on training opportunities, career pathways, and workforce resources.
* Support Career Seekers throughout their participation in education and training programs by identifying barriers and coordinating appropriate referrals.
* Case Management Self-Initiated Participants
* Manage an assigned caseload of self-initiated participants from enrollment through training completion or program exit.
* Maintain weekly contact with participants to monitor attendance, progress, and barriers to successful completion.
* Ensure timely follow-up, accurate documentation, and compliance with EARN and DHS requirements.
* Review participant progress and update Individual Employment Plans (IEPs) and goals
* Enter weekly progress notes
* Submit attendance records and timesheets on behalf of participants to ensure timely reporting of participation hours.
* Coordinate with Workforce Advisors, training providers, and the Data Department to maintain accurate participant records and support successful outcomes.
* Monitor credential attainment, employment placement, and retention milestones.

**Job Matching & Employment Services**

* Connect Career Seekers completing training with Job Developers to facilitate employment placement.
* Work collaboratively with Job Developers, Business Services Representatives, and Workforce Advisors to identify employment opportunities aligned with participant training credentials earned.
* Refer qualified Career Seekers to employment opportunities and hiring events.
* Maintain regular communication with internal staff regarding participant employment goals and progress.
* Develop and maintain partnerships with employers offering registered and non-registered apprenticeships and connect Career Seekers to apprenticeship opportunities that align with their interests and career goals.
* Attend regular meetings with funders, education and training providers, apprenticeship programs, and community partners.
* Coordinate career pathway information sessions, provider presentations, career exploration activities, and recruitment events.
* Plan and coordinate training-focused job fairs in collaboration with the Business Services Team and Job Developers.
* Maintain current information regarding available education, occupational skills training, apprenticeship, and credentialing opportunities; and promote among customers and staff.
* Coordinate with Workforce Advisors to ensure Career Seekers participating in training receive appropriate supportive services.
* Monitor Career Seekers participating in training and maintaining communication with Workforce Advisors, training providers, and Job Developers regarding participant progress.
* Complete training applications for interested Career Seekers and maintain comprehensive knowledge of each education and training program’s eligibility requirements, including entrance assessments, required entrance assessments (e.g., CASAS), background clearances, educational prerequisites, and other enrollment requirements
* Coordinate reverse referrals with Universal Services, WIOA Workforce Advisors to ensure Career Seekers are connected to appropriate education, training, and employment opportunities.

**Data Entry & Reporting**

* Prepare weekly reports on training referrals, participant engagement, provider activities, employment outcomes, and credential attainment. Ensure participant activity and outcomes are accurately documented in the Commonwealth Workforce Development System (CWDS), Salesforce, and other workforce information systems, as applicable.
* Track participant referrals to education, training, apprenticeship, and employment opportunities, and maintain accurate case progress notes and documentation in CWDS, Salesforce, and other workforce information systems.
* Collect, maintain, and verify program data to ensure timely, accurate, and complete reporting.
* Assist with collecting and maintaining program documentation in accordance with program requirements.
* Participate in meetings, training, and professional development activities.
* Support special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

**Core Competencies**

* Demonstrates professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, and sound judgment.
* Provides equitable and respectful service to individuals from diverse backgrounds, cultures, and life experiences.
* Builds collaborative relationships with Career Seekers, employers, training providers, community partners, and colleagues.
* Works effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Demonstrates flexibility and adapts to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Demonstrates initiative, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Possesses strong organizational, planning, and time management skills.
* Communicates effectively both verbally and in writing.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, virtual communication platforms, and CRMs.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred.

Requirements:

* Associate's or bachelor’s degree in human services, Social Work, Counseling, Education, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Two (2) or more years of experience in workforce development, career services, employment services, case management, education, or a related field.
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills.
* Build relationships with employers, training providers, and community partners.
* Strong organizational, documentation, and time management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and other computer applications.
* Excellent customer service, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills

3e20708fdd7da8005be3.description:
IT Support Specialist

**Location:** Boothwyn, PA (Hybrid)

**Work Schedule:** Full-Time | Hybrid

**Please Note:** This is a hybrid position based out of our Boothwyn, PA office. Candidates must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of Boothwyn, PA (19061).

**About Master Trades Group**
=============================

Master Trades Group (MTG) is one of the fastest-growing residential home services companies in the country, providing HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and sewer services through a family of trusted local brands across the Mid-Atlantic, Southeast, and Southwest.

Backed by private equity and focused on strategic growth, MTG partners with established local companies while providing the technology, operational support, and leadership needed to scale successfully. As we continue expanding through acquisitions, technology plays a critical role in supporting our employees and delivering an exceptional customer experience.

We're looking for an **IT Support Specialist** who enjoys solving technical problems, supporting end users, and working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

**Why Join Master Trades Group?**
=================================

* Competitive Compensation
* Hybrid Work Environment
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
* Company-Paid Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Professional Development & Certification Assistance
* Career Growth Opportunities within a Rapidly Expanding Organization

**Position Summary**
====================

The IT Support Specialist serves as the primary **Tier II IT resource** supporting Master Trades Group's corporate office and regional branch locations. While a third-party vendor provides Tier I support for Microsoft 365 and basic end-user issues, this role focuses on advanced desktop support, systems administration, business applications, networking, endpoint management, hardware lifecycle management, and local infrastructure support.

This position partners closely with internal employees and external technology vendors to maintain reliable IT operations while supporting new branch acquisitions, office expansions, and enterprise technology initiatives.

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
==================================

**Tier II Technical Support**
-----------------------------

* Resolve escalated desktop, laptop, printer, mobile device, and peripheral issues not handled by the Tier I support provider.
* Troubleshoot Windows operating systems, networking, VPN connectivity, hardware, and business application issues.
* Provide onsite and remote technical support for employees across multiple branch locations.
* Maintain excellent customer service while communicating technical solutions clearly to end users.

**Systems & Infrastructure Support**
------------------------------------

* Administer Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including user provisioning, permissions, security groups, and access management.
* Support Windows-based infrastructure, endpoint management, and device security.
* Assist with Microsoft Azure administration and hybrid cloud environments.
* Troubleshoot networking issues including DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP, wireless connectivity, and remote access.
* Support VoIP phone systems and conference room technology.

**Business Applications**
-------------------------

* Provide Tier II support for ServiceTitan, Sage Intacct, ADP, Egnyte, and other enterprise business applications.
* Coordinate with third-party vendors supporting Microsoft 365 and other managed services.
* Assist with software deployments, upgrades, testing, and issue resolution.

**IT Operations**
-----------------

* Manage computer imaging, hardware deployments, equipment replacements, warranty repairs, and technology lifecycle management.
* Maintain inventory of computers, mobile devices, peripherals, and other IT assets.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures.
* Ensure adherence to IT security standards and company policies.

**Projects**
------------

* Support technology implementations, office expansions, and acquisition integrations.
* Participate in infrastructure improvements and technology standardization initiatives.
* Research and recommend hardware and software solutions that improve operational efficiency.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* High School Diploma or GED.
* 3+ years of IT Support, Desktop Support, Systems Support, or Help Desk experience.
* Experience supporting Windows operating systems, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and enterprise desktop environments.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure or hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience troubleshooting networking issues including DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP, and wireless connectivity.
* Experience supporting business applications and multi-site environments.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple requests in a fast-paced environment.
* Valid driver's license with the ability to travel occasionally to branch locations.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience supporting ServiceTitan, Sage Intacct, ADP, Egnyte, or similar enterprise applications.
* Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot experience.
* Windows Server administration experience.
* Experience supporting acquisitions, office moves, or multi-location organizations.
* Residential home services or field service industry experience.
* PowerShell scripting experience.

### **Preferred Certifications**

* CompTIA Network+

**Temple University's Department of Criminal Justice at the College of Liberal Arts is searching for a Program Coordinator!**

Become a part of the Temple family and you will have access to the following:  
**A hybrid work schedule**  
**Full medical, dental, vision coverage**  
**Paid time off**  
**9 Federally Observed Paid Holidays**  
**3 Personal Days**  
**Tuition remission - eligible employees and their dependents can obtain a degree TUITION-FREE**  
**A generous retirement plan and so much more!**

**Salary Range:** $50,000 - $60,000  
*A variety of important factors are reviewed by HR when considering salary, including job duties, the applicant’s education and experience, all relevant internal equity considerations, department budget, and funding source.*

**Position Summary**  
The College of Liberal Arts is home to 30+ undergraduate majors, 42 minors, and 32 graduate degree programs. With its vibrant and diverse array of educational programs, the College of Liberal Arts plays a tremendous role in the university's academic success, and its mission mirrors both the historical importance of the liberal arts in society and the principles on which Temple University was founded. The college strives to prepare students for citizenship and careers, laying the foundation for a lifetime of learning, and teaching essential skills, including reading critically, thinking carefully, communicating effectively, appreciating diversity, and tolerating ambiguity. A liberal arts education from Temple helps students realize their aspirations and prepares them to meet the ever-changing cultural, intellectual, and economic demands of our society.

The mission of the Bachelor of Arts in Criminal Justice degree is to prepare students to think critically about criminal behavior, the operations of the criminal justice system, and the effectiveness and fairness of society’s efforts to prevent and address crime. Through an interdisciplinary and research-informed approach, students explore diverse perspectives on criminal behavior and the social harms associated with it, as well as the ways society responds to these challenges. Students develop an appreciation for the role of social science research in informing evidence-based crime and social policies and gain the knowledge and skills necessary to design and conduct rigorous research that advances understanding of contemporary criminal justice issues.

The Criminal Justice Program Coordinator supports student success, retention, and development by identifying students in need of academic support and outreach and connecting students with resources that support their academic, professional, and personal goals. The coordinator represents the Department of Criminal Justice at internal and external meetings and events, communicates program goals, promotes student responsibility and success, and serves as a liaison between the department and the CLA Advising and Professional Development Center. The coordinator provides program information to prospective freshmen and transfer students and supports CLA’s Office of Enrollment Management as needed. Working closely with Criminal Justice faculty and staff, the coordinator communicates and administers program, College, and University requirements and policies, shares resources and opportunities that support students, and collaborates with the Department Chair, Scheduling Coordinator, and Undergraduate Program Chair on curricular planning and course promotion.

Due to the front-facing nature of the Program Coordinator position, on-campus presence is required four days per week (8:30am – 4:30pm). Mondays will be the designated advising day.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

*LifeStance Health Values*

* Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.
* Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.
* Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.
* One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

*Benefits*  
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

**Job Summary:**

The Lead Practice Coordinator is responsible for the oversight of the front office daily activities for their assigned practice group locations, ensuring quality customer service to in-person and remote patients and clinicians.

  

**Compensation**: $25.25/hour, plus quarterly bonus/incentive potential

**Locations**: 88 Princeton Hightstown Rd #202, Princeton Junction, NJ 08550

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

**Operational Excellence:**

* Create a positive work environment; be a culture carrier and support in-office clinician and staff engagement activities to promote LFST culture, engagement, and connection.
* Conduct schedule preparation process for all patients to ensure paperwork and documentation is complete, credit card on file is current, demographics are accurate, and chart is prepared.
* General office duties to ensure the practice is running smoothly and prepared for patients and clinicians.
* Monitor Practice Group phone queue operational monitoring to ensure resources are aligned across the group to manage demand of incoming calls, while balancing other duties
* Coordinate efforts across Practice Coordinators to ensure KPI achievement.
* Lead the implementation of new processes at the practice level as they are rolled out by the Practice Group Manager or Clinical Director.
* Fill in gaps for front office staff vacancies as needed to ensure availability of resources to our patients and clinicians.

**Patient Support:**

* Provide exceptional customer service, responding quickly and appropriately to patient needs, and being prepared to manage potentially difficult or sensitive situations by following Crisis and De-escalation Processes.
* Manage front desk responsibilities including greeting and checking patients in/out in a courteous manner.
* Provide support across Practice Group to patients with requests via phone, email, and/or portal with payment/billing related questions, scheduling needs, release requests, etc.
* Manage any urgent requests; triage patient issues and resolution, i.e., direct to correct departments or escalate for assistance.
* Collect all in-person and telehealth co-payments and account balances at the time of service.
* Complete insurance eligibility verification, reach out to patients to resolve issues as needed.

**Clinician Support:**

**Practice Coordinator Support:**

* Troubleshoot workflow issues and implement workable solutions for Practice Coordinators.
* Lead onboarding and on-the-job training for new Practice Coordinators joining the organization.
* Ensure front office coverage across the Practice Group.
* Fill in for any practice coordinator vacancies as needed.
* Maintain a pleasant, secure, and motivational working environment.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to multitask and prioritize duties to support delivery of high-quality patient experience.
* Ability to work independently and as a team member.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Proficient in using Computer Software Applications (Microsoft Office & EMRs)
* Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential Information (HIPAA)
* Flexibility to travel between locations throughout the week

**Education and Experience:**

* High School or equivalent required, associates/bachelor’s degree preferred.
* 2+ years of demonstrated success in a healthcare operations role or 1+ year exceptional performance in similar role or setting.

**Professionalism and Decision-making Responsibilities:**

* Behave Ethically: Understand ethical behavior and business practices and ensure own behavior and the behavior of others are consistent with these standards and align with the values of the company.

**In Office and Travel Requirements:**

0e872faff6d45c71f54f.title: Inside Sales Account Manager – Managed Mobility Services
0e872faff6d45c71f54f.description:
Employment Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire  
Base Salary: $70,000–$80,000  
Commission: 5% on expanded and new-logo business

About the Opportunity

A growing technology and managed services organization is seeking an experienced Sales Account Manager to own, retain, and expand a portfolio of existing customer relationships. This position sits at the intersection of account management, customer success, consultative sales, and managed mobility solutions.

The successful candidate will inherit established customer relationships while taking an active role in increasing wallet share, identifying new business needs, re-engaging inactive customers, and expanding clients into a broader portfolio of technology and mobility services.

This is not a passive account-management or order-taking position. The ideal candidate is commercially minded, highly responsive, exceptionally organized, and comfortable turning an initial hardware or device request into a deeper conversation about the customer's operational needs.

The organization operates in Managed Mobility Services, supporting customers throughout the device lifecycle—from procurement and deployment through configuration, management, support, connectivity, and end-of-life solutions.

What You'll Do

Account Management & Customer Growth

* Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of existing customers.
* Build trusted relationships across IT, operations, procurement, field teams, leadership, and other key stakeholders.
* Maintain a high-touch customer experience through prompt communication, proactive updates, and consistent follow-through.
* Conduct regular account reviews, strategic check-ins, and QBRs to understand evolving customer needs.
* Protect existing revenue while actively identifying opportunities to expand customer relationships.

Consultative Selling & Account Expansion

* Uncover opportunities to expand customers beyond individual device purchases into broader managed solutions.
* Ask strategic discovery questions to understand the operational and financial challenges behind customer requests.
* Cross-sell and upsell solutions involving mobile devices, tablets, laptops, cellular routers, accessories, connectivity, MDM/UEM, staging and kitting, lifecycle support, depot services, buyback/ITAD, logistics, and related services.
* Partner with internal sales, operations, procurement, and technical teams to develop appropriate solutions, quotes, and proposals.
* Track account growth, solution adoption, cross-sell activity, revenue, and gross-profit performance.
* Support device-refresh planning, annual budgeting discussions, and longer-term account strategy.

Customer Reactivation & Proactive Outreach

* Proactively re-engage existing customers who have become inactive or have not purchased recently.
* Research account history and develop personalized outreach strategies rather than relying on generic "checking in" messaging.
* Identify why purchasing activity has declined and uncover new business needs, initiatives, budget considerations, or operational challenges.
* Maintain consistent multi-touch outreach and follow-up until a clear next step is established.
* Create reasons to remain valuable to customers even between active purchasing cycles.

Service Delivery & Relationship Ownership

* Act as the customer's advocate and escalation owner when service or delivery issues arise.
* Coordinate cross-functionally to drive issues through resolution while maintaining proactive communication with the customer.
* Set realistic expectations and remain accountable for outcomes even when another internal department performs the work.
* Monitor service performance, order fulfillment, asset tracking, lifecycle activity, and customer satisfaction.
* Maintain detailed and accurate CRM documentation, follow-up commitments, and next steps.

What We're Looking For

* Approximately 3–7+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Inside Sales, B2B relationship management, or a closely related commercial role.
* Strong preference for experience within managed mobility services, cellular/wireless solutions, telecom, mobility technology, managed IT services, device lifecycle services, or a closely related environment.
* Experience managing and growing post-sale customer relationships.
* Demonstrated success with upselling, cross-selling, account expansion, retention, and/or reactivation.
* Comfort with proactive outbound calling and outreach to existing or inactive customers.
* Ability to provide specific, measurable examples of revenue or account growth.
* Working knowledge of mobile and connected-device solutions, ideally including phones, tablets, laptops, cellular routers, connectivity, device management, deployment, and lifecycle considerations.
* Strong CRM and pipeline-management discipline; HubSpot or comparable CRM experience is preferred.
* Ability to manage a large number of contacts, simultaneous priorities, urgent customer requests, and ongoing sales opportunities without sacrificing follow-through.

What Makes Someone Successful Here

The strongest candidates combine a customer-success mindset with commercial drive. They are proactive rather than reactive, ask strong business questions, and understand that excellent customer service should ultimately create opportunities for deeper partnerships and account growth.

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Do what you say you are going to do and take ownership through resolution.
* Thrive in a fast-moving environment where customers expect timely responses.
* Know how to uncover the business problem behind a product request.
* Can turn an existing relationship into measurable incremental revenue.
* Are comfortable initiating conversations rather than waiting for customers to call.
* Build credibility with stakeholders at multiple levels of an organization.
* Remain calm and solutions-oriented during escalations.
* Keep exceptionally organized CRM notes, pipelines, tasks, and next steps.
* Can balance customer advocacy with clear revenue and growth objectives.

Success will be measured through factors including revenue and gross-profit growth, dormant-account reactivation, upsell/cross-sell conversion, customer retention/satisfaction, responsiveness, and adoption of broader managed solutions.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What experience makes you a great candidate for this position?

Experience:

* Managed Mobility Sales: 3 years (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Plymouth Meeting, PA 19462 (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Plymouth Meeting, PA 19462

df81be412be3a9c08938.title: Inbound Sales Specialist
df81be412be3a9c08938.description:
**Inbound Sales Specialist**
============================

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Remote  
**Apply here:** https://operationsarmy.com/application

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a motivated, customer-focused Inbound Sales Specialist to join a growing healthcare technology company. This is an opportunity for a sales professional who knows how to turn inbound inquiries into qualified opportunities and wants to develop their skills in consultative selling and closing.

This is not a traditional cold-calling role. You will primarily engage with prospects who have already expressed interest, understand their needs, explain relevant solutions, and guide them through the early stages of the sales process.

You should be comfortable managing a high volume of leads, conducting sales conversations over the phone and video, and following up consistently to keep opportunities moving. The ideal candidate combines strong communication skills with a competitive mindset, disciplined organization, and a desire to achieve measurable results.

You will initially work alongside an existing sales team, qualifying prospects and advancing opportunities. As you gain experience and demonstrate strong performance, you will take on greater responsibility for managing your pipeline and closing customers.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Inbound Sales & Lead Qualification**

* Respond promptly to inbound inquiries and engage prospective customers through phone and video conversations.
* Understand prospects’ needs, challenges, and goals through thoughtful questions.
* Qualify leads based on their needs, level of interest, and suitability for the company’s services.
* Identify customer pain points and determine appropriate next steps.
* Explain the company’s offerings and communicate their value clearly.
* Prioritize incoming leads and manage a high volume of prospect interactions.
* Schedule sales conversations and ensure qualified opportunities are passed to the appropriate team members.
* Maintain a positive and professional experience throughout each interaction.

### **Prospect Engagement & Follow-Up**

* Follow up consistently with interested prospects to maintain engagement and move opportunities forward.
* Re-engage prospects who have not responded or need additional time to make a decision.
* Address initial questions, understand concerns, and identify potential objections.
* Keep track of conversations, commitments, and follow-up deadlines.
* Manage multiple prospects without losing track of important opportunities.
* Support the sales team during periods of high inbound lead volume.
* Ensure every qualified prospect has a clear next step.

### **CRM & Sales Pipeline Management**

* Maintain accurate CRM records, including contact details, call notes, activities, and opportunity status.
* Document prospect needs, qualification outcomes, and follow-up plans.
* Keep sales information organized and current.
* Track sales activities and progress against established performance targets.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead response times, follow-up consistency, and conversion rates.
* Collaborate with sales colleagues to maintain visibility across the pipeline.

### **Growth Into Sales Closing**

As you develop product knowledge and demonstrate strong performance, you will have the opportunity to:

* Take ownership of qualified sales opportunities.
* Conduct discovery calls and sales conversations independently.
* Present solutions that address specific customer needs.
* Handle objections and guide prospects through purchasing decisions.
* Manage your own pipeline and maintain momentum toward closing.
* Take increasing responsibility for closing customers against agreed sales targets.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Must-Haves**

* At least 1–3+ years of experience in inside sales, sales development, business development, or a comparable customer-facing sales role.
* Experience handling a high volume of leads, prospect interactions, or sales conversations.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* A confident, professional phone presence and strong interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience qualifying prospects and identifying customer needs or pain points.
* Strong follow-up habits and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Experience working toward sales quotas, conversion targets, activity metrics, or similar KPIs.
* Experience using a CRM to track prospects, sales activities, and follow-ups.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to learn new products and explain their value to prospective customers.
* Self-motivated, coachable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Based in the United States and available during U.S. business hours.

### **Strong Plus**

* Previous experience in inbound sales or lead qualification.
* Experience conducting discovery calls or consultative sales conversations.
* Experience advancing opportunities or closing deals.
* SaaS or technology-enabled services sales experience.
* SMB sales experience.
* Healthcare technology sales experience.
* Experience managing short sales cycles and high lead volumes.
* A track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

Previous experience in the specific industry is not required. We value strong sales fundamentals, consistent execution, and the ability to learn quickly.

**Working Style**
-----------------

You should enjoy engaging with prospects, asking questions, understanding customer needs, and helping people determine whether a solution is right for them.

This role requires someone who understands that speed and consistency matter in inbound sales. You should be comfortable balancing multiple conversations, prioritizing leads, and following through without constant reminders.

You should also be motivated by measurable performance and willing to use coaching and feedback to improve. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work rather than simply completing assigned calls or tasks.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Success means responding promptly to inbound inquiries, qualifying prospects accurately, maintaining consistent follow-up, and helping the sales team convert interest into opportunities.

As you grow in the role, success will also mean managing a pipeline independently, leading effective sales conversations, handling objections, and closing customers against agreed targets.

If you’re organized, persistent, customer-focused, and motivated to grow your sales career, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply here:** https://operationsarmy.com/application

This role leads the strategy, architecture, and operations of Siemens Healthineers' cloud tenant infrastructure. The individual will oversee multi-tenant cloud environments, guide a team of architects and engineers, drive infrastructure projects, partner with global IT and cybersecurity teams, and ensure secure, scalable, and reliable cloud services across the organization. The ideal candidate brings 8-10+ years of cloud architecture and infrastructure leadership experience, with strong expertise in AWS, Azure, or GCP, cloud security, automation, and enterprise-scale IT operations.

**This is a role well suited for an experienced IT Expert looking for the next step in their career. As the IT Team Lead Service & Product Ownership (Cloud Tenants) for the DX business, you will be responsible for**:

  

* Building and owning the future DX Cloud Tenant Infrastructure that hosts a healthcare software platform with regulatory and certification requirements
* Being member of the Site and Support Operations team and helping to execute the vision of the Site and Support Operations leadership strategy
* Ownership of architecture and operation of all Cloud-based tenants for the infrastructure organization
* Operating the tenant with delegated rights and with staged rollout of tenant-wide changes
* Running subscription vending as an unattended pipeline and its downstream reporting
* Producing the operating evidence for the tenant's certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HITRUST) and supporting audits
